# Staged rotating concealment

The positive fixture preserves the bytes of a rotating-substitution
RealPlayer exploit page under a neutral filename. Its decoder, junk
camouflage, empty noscript frame, and escape-packed blobs must retain both
hostile composites. The control is a bare single-stage rotating decoder
with one small blob: it keeps the suspicious substitution writer but must
activate neither hostile composite, since a lone decoding stage with no
camouflage or cloak is not the kit assembly.
